messages.text: How can I order a black BS-4, the page shows white and black but when you add to cart, it doesn’t ask what color you want?

I've passed it to Georges to confirm which finish ships and whether black can be reserved for you. The team is offline right now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, with the answer by email, so what's the best address for you?
